open.desc: open a TCP/UDP transport handle; data and events arrive as deliveries serviced at yield()

param.desc: window (TCP in-flight deliveries per connection, default 1), expiry (UDP queue wait in ms, default 100), max_inflight (UDP outstanding deliveries, default 64)

ret.desc: net handle; an open failure throws RuntimeError

on_recv.desc: register the receive handler; each delivery calls handler(addr, data) at a yield() point

param.desc: root-scope def name, resolved when the delivery is serviced; def handler(addr, data), data is bytes

on_event.desc: register the connection event handler; handler(addr, connected), true = connected, false = disconnected

param.desc: root-scope def name; tcp_server reports per-peer connect/disconnect, tcp_client its connection drop, udp_trans nothing

send.desc: send bytes to one peer, or to every peer when addr is omitted

param.desc: payload (a string is accepted and sent as its bytes)
destination "a.b.c.d:port" as handed to the handler; required for udp_trans

ret.desc: false when the transport is closed or no matching peer accepted the bytes

disconnect.desc: disconnect one peer of a server handle; the listening socket keeps running

param.desc: peer address as handed to the handler

ret.desc: true on success; a client or udp handle throws ArgError

status.desc: delivery counters and the last transport error

ret.desc: {type, addr, closed, peers, rx, delivered, expired, full, errors, last_error}

close.desc: stop the transport, join its threads and drop the handle's deliveries
